mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_meeting_room (title, description, creator_id, status, max_rounds, current_round) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{creatorId}, #{status}, #{maxRounds}, #{currentRound})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_meeting_room SET status = #{status}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_meeting_room SET final_conclusion = #{finalConclusion}, conclusion_time = #{conclusionTime}, status = #{status}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_meeting_room SET current_round = #{currentRound}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_meeting_room SET summary = #{summary}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_meeting_room WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} ORDER BY gmt_create DESC
